title: Jewel-toned Whole Grain Earthy Spring Polish Flour Pancake
description: A vibrant and nourishing breakfast dish from Poland, perfect for the spring season. Features whole grain flour and infuse-oil for added depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: infuse-oil (chickpea oil infused with calendula petals)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, infuse-oil, ghee, egg, and salt until a smooth batter forms.
Stir in the chopped dill and honey.
Heat a tava or griddle to 37535F (19035C).
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the tava or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
